metadata.name: clashy
metadata.description: Clashy: PvP trading games (knockout duels, clans, clan wars, tournaments) on MagicBlock Ephemeral Rollups

instructions.name: call_round
docs: ER, player: calls up (1) or down (2) for the current round. Can be changed until the bell.

instructions.name: cancel_duel
docs: Refunds an unmatched duel: the creator any time, anyone after expiry. No rake.

instructions.name: cancel_tournament
docs: Creator cancels an unstarted tournament; remaining accounts are every player's wallet in join order.

instructions.name: cancel_war
docs: The declaring captain withdraws an unaccepted war; the stake goes back to the chest.

instructions.name: check_duel
docs: ER, permissionless (a crank or either player): scores both sides at the live price. When
someone is knocked out or the clock runs out, the duel finishes, is committed and goes home.

instructions.name: close_position
docs: Captain closes a clan position at the oracle price; the P&L feeds the clan's score.

instructions.name: coin_roll_callback
docs: VRF callback (only the VRF program can call it): picks the coin from the duel's pool.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: commit_pick
docs: Seals a pick: hash = sha256(side || leverage_le || salt).

instructions.name: delegate_duel
docs: Hands the duel to the ER once both picks are revealed.

instructions.name: execute_proposal
docs: Captain executes a passed proposal at the oracle price: opens a scored clan position.
Passed = more yes than no, and either the window closed or yes holds a chest majority.

instructions.name: init_base_feed
docs: A never-delegated copy of a coin's feed on Solana, for Solana-side reads (clan trades).
MagicBlock sponsors only a few commits per delegated account, so the rollup feeds are not
committed back; the crank writes this account directly instead.

instructions.name: leave_clan
docs: Leaves the clan. Withdraw your deposit first; the captain leaves last.

instructions.name: open_duel
docs: Opens a duel and escrows the creator's stake. With a short expiry it is a quick-match
ticket; with a long one it is an open challenge on the board.

instructions.name: propose
docs: Group trading: a member proposes a trade on the chest.

instructions.name: push_base_price
docs: Crank-only, on Solana.

instructions.name: push_price
docs: Crank-only. Works on Solana and inside the ER (where the feed is delegated).

instructions.name: reject_proposal
docs: Anyone can close a proposal that failed once its window is over.

instructions.name: request_coin_roll
docs: Asks MagicBlock VRF (base-layer queue) to roll the coin for both players.

instructions.name: request_tournament_coin
docs: Asks MagicBlock VRF to roll the tournament's coin (required on devnet / mainnet).

instructions.name: resolve_round
docs: ER, permissionless after the bell: wrong or missing calls lose a life. When one player (or
none) is left, or the last round ends, the tournament finishes and goes back to Solana.

instructions.name: reveal_seed
docs: Local fallback when no VRF oracle runs: both players reveal the seeds they committed at
open/join and the coin comes from sha256(seed_a || seed_b). Refused when VRF is required.

instructions.name: set_coin
docs: Sets coin `index` to read from `feed` (a Clashy PriceFeed or a MagicBlock oracle account).

instructions.name: settle_duel
docs: Solana: pays the pot (minus rake) to the winner, or refunds both on a tie; updates ratings.

instructions.name: settle_tournament
docs: Solana: players left with the most lives split the pot minus rake. Remaining accounts are
every player's wallet in join order.

instructions.name: settle_war
docs: After the window: the clan with the better return (score change over starting chest) takes
the pot minus rake into its chest; a tie refunds both.

instructions.name: start_duel
docs: ER: sets the entry price from the live feed and starts the clock.

instructions.name: start_tournament
docs: ER, creator: starts round 1 at the live price.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: vote
docs: Votes are weighted by the member's chest deposit; one vote per member per proposal.

instructions.name: withdraw_chest
docs: Withdraws your own deposit. Blocked while the clan is at war (the chest backs the war pot).

fields.name: chest
docs: Lamports deposited into the chest vault (members' deposits).

fields.name: score_pnl
docs: Realized paper P&L of the clan's voted trades, in lamports of notional.

fields.name: feed
docs: Price account for this coin: a Clashy `PriceFeed` (crank-pushed) or a MagicBlock oracle account.

fields.name: crank
docs: Pushes prices into Clashy feeds (a keeper reading a public price API).

fields.name: vrf_required
docs: When true (devnet / mainnet), coins are rolled only by MagicBlock VRF.
When false (local stack without a VRF oracle), a two-party commit-reveal roll is allowed.

types.name: Duel
docs: A 1v1 knockout duel. Stakes sit in the `vault` PDA on Solana; the duel itself is
delegated to the ER while it is live.

fields.name: pool_mask
docs: Bitmask over config coins the roll may pick.

fields.name: seed_hash
docs: Commit-reveal seeds for the local roll (unused when VRF rolls).

fields.name: pick_hash
docs: Sealed picks: sha256(side || leverage_le || salt).

fields.name: pnl_bps
docs: Leveraged P&L in basis points of stake, per player.

fields.name: winner
docs: 0 none, 1 creator, 2 joiner, 3 tie.

types.name: PriceFeed
docs: Clashy-owned price feed. Delegated to the ER and updated about every second by the crank;
the crank commits it back to Solana periodically so base-layer reads stay fresh.

types.name: Tournament
docs: An on-chain Royale: escrowed entries, up/down calls each round on the ER, last one standing.

fields.name: calls
docs: 0 no call, 1 up, 2 down, for the current round.

fields.name: return_bps
docs: Return in basis points of the starting chest, recorded at settlement.

fields.name: winner
docs: 0 none, 1 clan A, 2 clan B, 3 tie.
